terms.gloss: a migraine, a pain on one side of the head
evidence: Marc. Emp. 2; Cael. Aur. Tard. 1.1.4 (Lewis & Short s.v. hēmicrānium)
terms.comment: From Greek ἡμικράνιον, “half the skull”; it is the word behind French migraine. Lewis & Short cites only late medical writers.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 345.
